name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet
prompt: 32x32 pixel art sprite of a single Janissary serving aboard an Ottoman war galley, standing braced as if against a rolling deck, rendered across eight compass-direction rotations, isolated on a transparent background, no environment. Male, late 20s, broad-shouldered and barrel-chested, deeply sun-darkened skin and salt-cracked lips from months at sea, a thick black mustache with clean-shaven chin, dark hair beneath a white felt börk tied down at the sides with a leather cord against sea wind, its brass kaşıklık holder pitted with salt corrosion. Wearing a deep blue kaftan, shorter and less encumbering than a land soldier's for scrambling over rigging, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a plain rope-like sash, loose şalvar trousers rolled at the calf, bare feet or simple rope-soled sandals for grip on wet planking. A coil of rope slung over one shoulder, a heavy boarding axe gripped in one hand for hooking and hacking through an enemy hull, a short matchlock and a yatağan both secured at the waist for the close, brutal fighting of a galley boarding action. Rope-burn calluses across the palms. Expression hard, ready, eyes narrowed as if already watching an enemy sail. Bold, saturated period-appropriate color palette, thick clean black outlines for silhouette clarity at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
